title: Volume 1 Chapter 2: 7th Squad Edition 3
content: "When this is over, we'll train in Mato again."
"I know."
Himari and Yuki repeated their rigorous training.
August 11th.
As Yuki was organizing the refrigerator, Nei came trotting over.
"Yuki-san, will the kitchen be free after this?"
"Yeah, I won't be using it for a while."
"Is it alright if I borrow it for a bit?"
Of course.
By the way, there are ingredients in the fridge under your name, Nei-chan.
Would you like some help if you're making something?
"Thank you!"
Nei grabbed Yuki's hand and shook it vigorously.
"You always take such good care of me, Yuki-san."
"That's an exaggeration."
"Actually, I have a summer vacation research project."
(Nei-chan is doing her summer homework while being in the Anti-Demon Corps? That's impressive.)
"So, what are you researching?"
"I'm going to make maki sushi."
"Maki sushi?"
"Yes, the theme of my research is maki sushi!"
"That's... unique."
"Hehe. The person who took me in before loves maki sushi. They can eat it with one hand while working."
"So that's why you want to research maki sushi?"
Yes.
I've already finished researching the history of maki sushi and its characteristics across different regions of Japan.
Now it's time to try making it.
"You've got a solid plan."
"Actually, I was supposed to be done by now."
Well, it's understandable since the work in the Anti-Demon Corps has gotten busy.
Do you know how to make maki sushi?
I mean, I guess you can find it online.
Yes.
There are also methods for practice.
For example, using black felt as nori and white felt as rice to roll it up.
I did that as part of my research.
"You're well-prepared."
"Always be prepared."
"Can I watch you while you make it?"
"Thank you! Can I ask you to taste it as well?"
"Gladly. Having a third-party comment would be good for your research."
"I'll do my best to roll it up!"
Nei efficiently finished her preparations and began making the maki sushi.
"Spread the sushi rice over the nori... leaving about three centimeters of space at the back..."
"It's better to spread the sushi rice as evenly as possible."
"Yes, evenly, evenly."
"Yeah, looking good."
"Now, let's add the ingredients...!"
"This moment is so fun."
Egg omelet, cucumber, shiitake mushrooms, kanpyou, oboro, crab-flavored kamaboko... various ingredients were carefully placed.
"Um, let's place the egg omelet in the center..."
"You're placing them really carefully. Your hands are shaking a little."
I'm taking pictures as part of my research.
More than anything, since Yuki-san will be eating it, I want it to be something special.
And so, Nei meticulously crafted the maki sushi.
"I'm going to roll it with all my might to make it delicious."
(I can tell that Nei-chan is definitely a member of the 7th Squad.)
"Mmm, please become delicious..."
She even used honorifics when talking to the sushi.
"Ah, I'm done rolling it."
"It's better to let the nori settle a bit before cutting it."
"I understand. I'll let it sit. Mmm, please become even more delicious...!!"
Nei sent her thoughts to the rolled sushi.
After a while, the maki sushi was cut into eight pieces, and Nei took a picture of it.
"Yeah, it looks delicious."
"I'll try making different variations of it before summer vacation ends."
"That's a really thorough research."
"If the timing works out, please try it again."
"I'd love to eat your cooking every day, Nei-chan."
"Yuki-san..."
The two of them cleaned up together.
"What are you going to do after this, Yuki-san?"
"I'm going to fold the laundry."
"Let me help you as a thank you for the maki sushi."
"Thanks, I appreciate it, Nei-chan."
Nei smiled happily.
August 12th.
Shushu was in love with Yuki Wakura.
She devised numerous plans to capture his heart.
(Hmm, for example, how about setting up a base at the mountain summit and playing with Yuki?
Hiking would make us both feel liberated...
It could be a great date course.
If we decide to go climbing, we could also do some shopping beforehand, which would definitely give us a chance to be alone together.
If we have a climbing date, there will be many opportunities to hold hands, as I've read online.)
However, Shushu was also aware of her responsibilities as a member of the 7th Squad.
(No, I'm getting too carried away with the idea of playing. I need to reflect on that.)
Neglecting the extermination of Shuki while being preoccupied with love would make her unfit as Kyouka's subordinate.
While it's important to rest, during mission time, she focused on exterminating Shuki, which was Shushu's policy.
Thus, the plan she devised to win over Yuki was:
"You're saying Shushu will patrol while giant-sized?"
"Yes, the grown-up me will have the leader and Yuki ride on me. Then I'll stroll through Mato."
"Are you saying that Shuki hiding behind the giant you might react?"
"Yes. The leader and Yuki will be able to search from a different perspective."
"Hmm, we should try everything at least once."
(Alright, I'll execute the plan to hunt Shuki while making Yuki's heart race.
The ability to grow big is a unique trait of mine.
I learned online that some boys like big girls.
It might resonate with Yuki's preferences.
I really want to go out with Yuki alone, but if something happens, it would be dangerous for him.)
Thus, Shushu's next plan was set in motion.
Before the patrol time, Shushu carefully polished her body.
Since she would be growing large, she might stand out if something went wrong.
That could turn her carefully devised plan into a disadvantage.
I'm quite brilliant, aren't I?
If I were a character in a game, my intelligence would probably be around ninety-seven.
Saying such things, Shushu continued to refine herself.
"Alright, Yuki. Let's go on patrol."
The now twenty-meter-tall Shushu extended her hand.
Yuki jumped onto her hand.
"Handle with care, please."
"I got it."
Yuki climbed onto Shushu's head.
"My head is as safe as a peaceful countryside road."
Yuki gripped the ribbon on Shushu's head tightly.
"I feel like a protagonist from a robot anime."
"How's the ride?"
"It's nice. It smells good, like shampoo."
"Hehe, if it's Yuki, I might let you ride on me sometimes."
Kyouka also came out of the dorm.
"You're ready, good."
Kyouka quickly climbed onto Shushu's shoulder using her own strength.
"I'll carry you to the shoulder properly, Leader."
"Don't worry about it. Yuki, sudden gusts can hit in Mato. Don't fall."
"Yes."
"Alright, go, Shushu. Depart for patrol."
"Understood, Shushu Suruga, launching!"
With Yuki and Kyouka riding on her, Shushu walked through Mato.
"Oh, this is an interesting perspective. I can see the ground of Mato well."
"Follow Nei's clairvoyance and pay attention to the details."
"This is quite thrilling when looking down."
"That thrill is what makes it interesting."
"Overcome your fear, Yuki."
Yuki thought to himself how strong the women around him were.
As Shushu walked, she remained vigilant of her surroundings.
Yuki, on Shushu's head, and Kyouka, on her shoulder, kept watch for anything in Shushu's blind spots.
(Alright, I've gotten quite used to being on Shushu-chan's head.)
Just as Yuki thought that, Shushu lightly scratched her cheek with her finger.
"Whoa, what was that?"
"Oh. Sorry, sorry. I should have said something."
At this size, even a slight movement had considerable impact.
"I'm surprisingly scared when I'm not in slave form."
That's a normal reaction.
It would be troubling if you, a guy, were overly confident in Mato.
Be cautious.
It's not good to be overly fearful, but you need to be careful.
Shushu's fighting style, which swept away Shuki without mercy, was well-suited for the area the 7th Squad was responsible for, where Shuki appeared in large numbers.
Suddenly, a gust of wind blew.
Yuki held onto Shushu's ribbon to avoid falling, while Kyouka remained calmly on her shoulder.
"I'm going to investigate that rocky area."
"I'm lowering you."
"There's no need to worry."
Kyouka slid down Shushu's body and landed on the rocky area.
"Yuki, don't imitate the leader."
"I won't, I'd die if I did."
"...Oh no, this is bad. I'm about to sneeze."
"Wait a moment, I'll hold on tightly."
"Ha, ha, ha."
"Alright, I'm good."
"Ha-choo!"
Shushu swayed more than expected, but Yuki was prepared, so he didn't fall.
"Haah, haah. It's like a roller coaster."
"Should I put you in my palm?"
"That would be a problem if your palm is occupied."
"How about I put you in my mouth? Just kidding."
"I think there's a fish that does that, where it carries small fish in its mouth."
"Then how about a pocket?"
Saying that, Shushu placed Yuki in her back pocket.
"I can cover your blind spot, but this is a bit..."
"Huh!? There's a Shuki! Yuki, stay still there!"
"Whaaat!?"
As Shushu ran, the momentum caused Yuki's body to sway inside her pocket.
Moreover, since he was in her back pocket, his entire body was enveloped by her backside's softness.
As Shushu moved her legs, the closeness intensified.
(If Shushu-chan falls on her backside, I'm going to get crushed!)
Yuki felt anxious, but Shushu was careful while fighting, literally kicking Shuki away.
Exhausted, Yuki was rescued from the pocket.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gM4advu.jpeg
"Are you okay, Yuki?"
"I-I'm somehow fine."
"There was nothing particularly there at the rocky area. Shushu, great job on the Shuki extermination."
Thus, the new patrol attempt yielded results in exterminating Shuki, but there were no particularly novel discoveries.
"Yuki. If you ever want to ride me again, just let me know."
"I think I'm fine except when necessary."
"Hmm."
Shushu began to devise her next plan without losing heart.
